verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.firehydrant.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a FireHydrant documentation header), so an agent can be pointed at it. Several docs pages are also served as raw .md, which agents can read easily. Missing for 10: evidence of how complete or well-structured the llms.txt index is (e.g. an llms-full.txt), and first-party guidance or independent corroboration of agent-oriented docs usage.
